newsitem.title: CANADA: Hearing set for TransCanada power line plan.
newsitem.headline: Hearing set for TransCanada power line plan.

text.p: Canada's National Energy Board said it would hold a public hearing on an application by TransCanada PipeLines Ltd unit TransCanada Power to build a power line to southern Alberta from the United States.
TransCanada wants to build the 15 km, 69-kilovolt line to power electric motors and other facilities at the Wild Horse pumping station of the Express oil pipeline, which is now under construction.
The C$580-million Express line, a 50-50 joint venture of TransCanada and Alberta Energy Co Ltd, is being built to carry oil to Casper, Wyoming from Hardisty, Alberta.
The capital cost of the Canadian portion of the transmission line was estimated at C$725,000.
The hearing is scheduled to start on December 9 in Calgary, the NEB said.
